column1: Signup accepts a 7-character password although the minimum is 8
column28:
*Precondition*

Signup page is open and the user is logged out

*Steps to Reproduce*

# Open the Echoverse Signup page
# Enter First Name, Last Name, a unique valid email, and the password values from Test Data
# Click Signup

*Test Data*

First Name: Test
Last Name: User
Email: [usertest@gmail.com|mailto:usertest@gmail.com]
Password: Test@12
Confirm Password: Test@12

*Severity :* Medium

*Priority*: High

*Expected Result*

Password is not accepted: an error about the minimum length (8 characters) is shown. Account is not created and the user stays on the Signup page

*Actual Result*

Account is created and the user is redirected to the Login page

*Environment* :localhost:8000, Chrome, Windows 11
